notes: ERCOT's official Load Zone map shades the City of Austin service area as the "Austin Energy (AEN)" load zone, distinct from the surrounding "South" zone. Austin Energy is a municipally owned utility and one of ERCOT's four Non-Opt-In Entity (NOIE) Load Zones (Austin, CPS, LCRA, RAYBN). Settlement point name LZ_AEN verified live against ERCOT NP6-905-CD (spp_node_zone_hub): returned a real-time settlement point price row dated 2026-09-25 with settlementPoint=LZ_AEN.

ERCOT Board memo (Item 10, Oct 17 2023 Board meeting) quotes Nodal Protocol Section 3.4.3(1)(d): "NOIEs may participate in only one NOIE Load Zone, and all Loads served by that NOIE must be contained within that Load Zone," and confirms LCRA's NOIE Load Zone is LZ_LCRA. Pedernales Electric Cooperative (PEC) serves unincorporated western/northwestern Travis County outside the Austin Energy footprint and is one of LCRA's four current wholesale electric cooperative customers (Bandera, Bluebonnet, Hamilton County, Pedernales - per lcra.org/energy/electric-power/, retrieved 2026-09-25) with roughly 65%+ of PEC's load supplied by LCRA as of the 2024 annual report, so PEC load is settled in LZ_LCRA under the protocol above, not the surrounding LZ_SOUTH zone. Settlement point name LZ_LCRA verified live against ERCOT NP6-905-CD: returned a real-time price row dated 2026-09-25 with settlementPoint=LZ_LCRA.

Same ERCOT protocol basis as the Pedernales row above (Section 3.4.3(1)(d): all load served by an NOIE must sit in that NOIE's single Load Zone). Bluebonnet Electric Cooperative serves southeastern Travis County and is a current LCRA wholesale customer under an at-cost power supply contract running through 2041 (lcra.org customer list, retrieved 2026-09-25), so its Travis County load settles in LZ_LCRA. ERCOT's own precedent memos (e.g. the Dec 2025 Lamar Electric Cooperative Board item) describe co-ops moving into or out of "LCRA NOIE Load Zone" as their LCRA wholesale contracts start or end, confirming LZ_LCRA is the zone tied to LCRA's co-op customers rather than a fixed geography. Settlement point name LZ_LCRA verified live against ERCOT NP6-905-CD (see row above).
